tests.name: two real tabs merge independent fields and receive storage events
two real tabs preserve competing drafts and reject stale conflict choices
actual reload prompt protects failed work; accepted reload restores only durable work
queued real Web Lock save is guarded until the lock is released
denied reads and malformed records keep local text and durable bytes unchanged
native Chromium quota exhaustion retains the latest answer and the previous durable bytes
legacy direct writes are detected on retry without migrating a bookmark to revised text
real reader downloads readable anonymous recovery and keeps reload protection
real reader restores a copy as a draft and saves only after explicit confirmation

limitation: Legacy tabs do not participate in Web Locks. Detection on retry is tested; atomic safety against arbitrary legacy writers is not claimed.
